# Copilot Instructions

This project is a generic Laravel skeleton for Linnworks External Channel integrations.

When implementing a vendor integration:

- read `.ai/skills/linnworks-channel-integration/SKILL.md`;
- use `.ai/agents/linnworks-channel-initializer.md` as the workflow;
- keep Linnworks endpoint contracts stable;
- keep mock endpoints and tests aligned with enabled capabilities;
- do not log secrets or hard-code credentials.
